**Nvidia had the higher gross margin in fiscal 2025, by about 28.1 percentage points.** These figures are from my recollection of the companies' 10-K filings rather than checked against them.

| Company | Fiscal year end | Revenue | Gross profit | Gross margin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nvidia | Jan 26, 2025 | $130,497M | $97,858M | ≈ 75.0% |
| Apple | Sep 27, 2025 | $416,161M | $195,201M | ≈ 46.9% |

Gross margin is gross profit divided by revenue. Subtracting Apple's margin from Nvidia's gives 74.99% − 46.91% ≈ 28.1 percentage points.

The two fiscal years end about eight months apart.
